archetypes.name: dyn-dispatch-parity
archetypes.rationale: Shared Python action helpers now drive formerly separate retained and merged dispatch paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on parity between design step2b5, postplan-emit --with-plan-size, and step2b-postplan rc handling. Verify that rc 2, hard, partition, drift, and under-threshold actions preserve existing branch behavior across retained and merged callers. Check tests pin the shared priority contract rather than reintroducing prompt-side derivation. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
